note: Bihar PGMAC-2026 revised Round 1 seat matrix (BCECEB): 1,148 seats. Government colleges: 386 state quota MD/MS seats by category (SC 16%, ST 1%, EBC 18%, BC 12%, RCG 3% for reserved-category girls, EWS 10%, with seats for women within each), and 5% of seats for the disabled quota (DQ) within these; the state diploma seats, half open and half for in-service doctors who served three years in remote areas; post-MBBS DNB (41) and NBEMS diploma (63) seats for regular Bihar government in-service doctors. Private colleges: 648 seats split into state (unreserved), Muslim or Sikh minority and NRI seats.
